verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              ततः सर्वासु मायासु हतासु दितिनन्दनाः। हिरण्यकशिपुं सर्वे विषण्णाः शरणं गताः॥१॥
verses.english: Then all of a sudden, an entity has emerged riving the thigh of sage ऊर्व, which is enwreathed in fuelless flames and agog to burn down the universe… that all-ending fire came out of sage ऊरु’स् thigh is called और्व-फ़िरे, a highly furious fire capable of reducing all the three worlds to ashes…

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रज्वलितः क्रोधात्प्रदहन्निव तेजसा। हिरण्यकशिपुर्देत्यश्चालयामास मेदिनीम्॥२॥
verses.english: “सोम,” इन्द्र said to moon in a war-warm-up mood, “join hands with the wielder of noose, raingod वरुण, in destroying demons and for the victory to the inhabitants of the sky…

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रक्षुभिताः सर्वे सागराः सलिलाकराः। चलिता गिरयः सर्वे सकाननवनदुमाः॥३॥
verses.english: With sprawling lions, tigers and elephants, and uproarious with roaring soldiery - यूथपा-s = माया-योद्धा-s; further, those mountains are infested with hosts of - ईहा-मृग गणा-s – AI creatures, automated monsters, robots, and cybots etc. while the wind-hit trees are swaying, uprooting and falling distantly on targets…

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्क्रुद्धे तु दैत्येन्द्रे तमोभूतमभूज्जगत्। तमसा सममूच्छन्नं न प्राज्ञायत किञ्चन॥४॥
verses.english: When इन्द्र achieved victory and demon मय met with discomfiture, all the quarters became clear and Vedic rituals recommenced…

verses.sanskrit: आवहः प्रवहश्चैव विवहश्च समीरणः। परावहः संवहश्च उद्वहश्च महाबलः॥५॥
verses.english: A regularly correlative waxing and waning, or ebbing and tiding are manifest in you and in ocean, while you two are capable of recouping the waned and ebbed portion of yours… as such, you joins hands with ocean god varuNa to combat demons… because you spin day and night you are a calibrator for time measurement…

verses.sanskrit: तथा परिवहः श्रीमान्मारुता भयशंसिनः। इत्येते क्षुभिताः सप्त मारुता गगनेचराः॥६॥
verses.english: Air infused with fire and fire suffused with air, and undergoing an ictus of era-ending anger, as it were, that twosome airfire has incinerated the demonic army …

verses.sanskrit: ये ग्रहाः सर्वलोकस्य क्षये प्रादुर्भवन्ति वै। ते ग्रहा गगने हृष्टा विचरन्ति यथासुखम्॥७॥
verses.english: Abiding above the solar path and other luminous bodies you dispel gloom and brighten the entire world with your body and beams…

verses.sanskrit: अयोगतश्च तारासु सर्वेष्वृक्षेषु सङ्गताः। सग्रहं सहनक्षत्रं प्रजज्वाल नमो नृप॥८॥
verses.english: Medicne-lord, measure-for-ritual-events, fount-for-ritual-water, heatless-candent, cold-rayed, cornerstone-of-अम्ब्रोसिa, mercurial-natured, vehicle-silvery…

verses.sanskrit: विवर्णत्वं च भगवान्गतो दिवि दिवाकरः। कृष्णः कबन्धश्च महाँल्लक्ष्यते च नभस्तले॥९॥
verses.english: You are lambency, enviable by you conformation, elixir of life, and the life of those who depend on your elixir, सोम-रस, namely सोम-जीविका-स्, i.e., gods who are the sippers of सोम… your charm charms in every charming object, dispeller of darkness for every being, and you are the star-lord…
verses.bhavadeepa: अयोगतः यथोक्तवृद्धिह्राससम्बन्धं विनातीव बुद्ध्यातीव ह्रासेन च नियतगतिरप्यनियतं जगाम॥८॥

verses.sanskrit: अमुञ्चच्चासितां सूर्यो धूमवर्तिं भयावहाम्। गगनस्थश्च भगवानभीक्ष्णं परितप्यते॥१०॥
verses.english: Such as you are you charge with your array accompanying raingod वरुण, and quench this factitious fire with which we are being burnt…” so said indra to soma…
verses.bhavadeepa: विवर्णत्वं निष्प्रभत्वं कबन्धो राहुरदृश्योपि दृश्यत्वं गत इत्यर्थः॥९॥

verses.sanskrit: सप्त धूमनिभा घोराः सूर्या दिवि समुत्थिताः। सोमस्य गगनस्थस्य ग्रहास्तिष्ठन्ति शृङ्गगाः॥११॥
verses.english: Such as you are you charge with your array accompanying raingod वरुण, and quench this factitious fire with which we are being burnt…” so said indra to soma…

verses.sanskrit: वामे च दक्षिणे चैव स्थितौ शुक्रबृहस्पती। शनैश्चरो लोहिताङ्गो लोहितार्कसमद्युतिः॥१२॥
verses.english: “With which confidence you are asking me to combat the whirlfire that I will keep up by just storming icestorms on demons that repulses this fictional whirlfire… you may behold how demons will be divested of their wizardry and haughtiness when burnt with my chill and covered with sleet…” so said moon to indra…
verses.bhavadeepa: सप्त ग्रहाः सोमस्य शृङ्गगा इति योजना॥११॥

verses.sanskrit: समं समभिरोहन्ति दुर्गाणि गगनेचराः। शृङ्गाणि कनकैर्घोरा युगान्तावर्तका ग्रहाः॥१३॥
verses.english: Then dew-maker moon hurled sleetstorms mixed with raindrops and snow that spiralled round the deadly demons like cloudcovers…

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रमाः सह नक्षत्रैर्ग्रहैः सप्तभिरावृतः। चराचरविनाशार्थं रोहिणी नाभ्यनन्दत॥१४॥
verses.english: Those two, the raingod - the wilder of noose; and the moongod - the wielder of moonbeams; started striking the demons with snowfalls and rainfalls…

verses.sanskrit: गृहीतो राहुण चन्द्र उल्काभिरभिहन्यते। उल्काः प्रज्वलिताश्चन्द्रे प्रचेलुर्घोरदर्शनाः॥१५॥
verses.english: Those two, the raingod - the wilder of noose; and the moongod - the wielder of moonbeams; started striking the demons with snowfalls and rainfalls…

verses.sanskrit: देवानामपि यो देवः सोऽभ्यवर्षत शोणितम्। अपतन्गगनादुल्का विद्युद्रूपाः सनिःस्वनाः॥१६॥
verses.english: Terrorising hosts of gods, pervading all ten directions, he looked to have risen as an overbearing and overwrought Death appearing at era-endings…

verses.sanskrit: अकाले पादपाः सर्वे पुष्यान्ति च फलन्ति च। लताश्च सफलाः सर्वा याः प्राहुर्दैत्यनाशनम्॥१७॥
verses.english: Seeing such a demon काल-नेमि on the battlefield, one who is like Death himself unto his enemies, the hearts of celestials wobbled with fear…

verses.sanskrit: विक्रोशान्ति च गम्भीरं धूमयन्ति ज्वलान्ति च। प्रतिमाः सर्वदेवानां कथयन्ति युगक्षयम्॥१९॥
verses.english: His arms appeared to be maintaining equiponderance of skies, his feet footballing mountains, and suspires shoving black-clouds to smithereens…

verses.sanskrit: आरण्यैः सह संसृष्टा ग्राम्याच मृगपक्षिणः। चुक्रुशुर्भैरवं तत्र मृगेन्द्रे समुपस्थिते॥२०॥
verses.english: On hearing about the terror experienced by the opposers of gods - पूर्व-देवा-s - namely daityA-s, caused to the maximum by firegod and airgod, a demon renowned as काल-नेमि appeared on the battlefield…

verses.sanskrit: नद्यश्च प्रतिलोमा हि वहन्ति कलुषोदकाः। अपराह्णगते सूर्ये लोकानां क्षयकारके॥२१॥
verses.english: Thereupon beholding the dreadful demon काल-नेमि approach like death himself all the gods headed by इन्द्र have undergone a macabre eeriness…

verses.sanskrit: न प्रकाशन्ति च दिशो रक्तरेणुसमाकुलाः। वानस्पत्या न पूज्यन्ते पूजनार्हाः कथञ्चन॥२२॥
verses.english: On observing the sore straits of his troopers, where some fettered with the noose of raingod and some flaked with snow-flakes, दानव माय could notice the fade of phantastic fire… then he embarked on another phantasm, माया-पर्वत-माय, a trick with tricksy-mountains…

verses.sanskrit: वायुवेगेन हन्यन्ते भिद्यन्ते प्रणुदन्ति च। तदा च सर्वभूतानां छाया न परिवर्तते॥२३॥
verses.english: In that trick demon माय spun off spanning ranges of mountains with rocky crags and cliffs, peaks thick with thickets of gigantic trees, mountainsides spread with yawning caves and fusty forests…

verses.sanskrit: अपराह्णगते सूर्ये लोकानां च युगक्षये। तदा हिरण्यकशिपोर्दैत्यस्योपरिवेश्मनः॥२४॥
verses.english: With sprawling lions, tigers and elephants, and uproarious with roaring soldiery - यूथपा-s = माया-योद्धा-s; further, those mountains are infested with hosts of - ईहा-मृग गणा-s – AI creatures, automated monsters, robots, and cybots etc. while the wind-hit trees are swaying, uprooting and falling distantly on targets…

verses.sanskrit: भाण्डागारायुधागारे निविष्टमभवन्मधु। तथैव चायुधागारे धूमराजिरदृश्यत॥२५॥
verses.english: Thus, this is the forty-sixth chapter of first canto called harivamsha-parva, in harivamsha-purANa, the sequel of mahAbhArata, narrating the defeat of demons and the entrance of demon काल-नेमि into god-demon war.
verses.bhavadeepa: अपराह्णगतेऽपि सूर्ये छाया न परिवर्तते निप्रभत्वात्सूर्यस्येत्यर्थः॥२४॥

verses.sanskrit: स च दृष्ट्वा महोत्पातान्हिरण्यकशिपुस्तदा। पुरोहितं तदा शुक्रं वचनं चेदमब्रवीत्॥२६॥
verses.english: While supervising demon क्रौञ्च assaulted gods with sonorous fizzing of rocks, storms of stones, plunging of trees, and by strewing iron clouds and rocks on the hosts of gods on the battle-field… simultaneously he re-animated demons making the illusion spun by raingod futile and dissipated…

verses.sanskrit: किमथ भगवन्नन्ते महोत्पाताः समुत्थिताः। श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वेन परं कौतूहलं हि मे॥२७॥
verses.english: With a hundred arms upraised to strike in hundred ways, that glorious hundred-faced demon stood like a hundred-peaked-mountain spanning his hundred heads…

verses.sanskrit: फले फलान्यजायन्त पुष्पे पुष्पं तथैव च। उन्मीलन्ति निमीलन्ति हसन्ति च रुदन्ति च॥२८॥

शुक्र उवाच।
              श्रणु राजन्नवहितो वचनं मे महासुर। यदर्थमिह दृश्यन्ते महोत्पाता महाभयाः॥२८॥
यस्यैते सम्प्रदृश्यन्ते राज्ञो राष्ट्रे महासुर। देशो वा ह्रियते तस्य राजा वा बन्धमर्हति॥२९॥
verses.english: Although the glorious one and the lord of the universe, गदा-धर, aka विष्णु, is available on the battlefield from the start, he is unperturbed and unexcited with anger on account of his compos mentis – सहिष्णुत्वम्…

verses.sanskrit: अतो बुद्ध्या समीक्षस्व यथा सर्वं प्रणश्यति। बृहद्भयं हि न चिराद्भविष्यति न संशयः॥३०॥
verses.english: Wishful to see the mutual onslaught of gods and demons, thereby to assess their strengths and weaknesses, he who resembles a black-cloud arriving at the era-end, and who is conversant with timing of events, that god जनार्दन, aka विष्णु, waited for the proper time to enter into the picture of battle…

verses.sanskrit: एतावदुक्त्वा शुक्रस्तु हिरण्यकशिपुं तदा। स्वस्तीत्युक्त्वा तु दैत्येन्द्रं जगाम स्वं निवेशनम्॥३१॥
verses.english: Thereupon entering on proper time विष्णु ordered the firegod and airgod to deal with the phantastic-mountain-combat created by मय-असुर in that war…

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्गते स दैत्येन्द्रो ध्यातवान्सुचिरं तदा। आसाञ्चक्रे सुदीनात्मा ब्रह्मवाक्यमनुस्मरन्। असुराणां विनाशाय सुराणां विजयाय च॥३२॥
verses.english: Then firegod and airgod who for themselves are the illimitable entities have now joined hands to become a two-in-one preponderance at the behest of विष्णु to drag-anchor the magic-mountain-sortie from field…

verses.sanskrit: दृश्यन्ते विविधोत्पाता घोरा घोरनिदर्शनाः। एते चान्ये च बहवो घोरा द्युत्पातदर्शनाः॥३३॥
verses.english: When that असुर काल-नेमि put his best foot forward on the battlefield as war-tramping, for which stamping the airgod could shove his loincloth a little aside, which terrorised all the gods since it indicated that he is primed up for a fresh war – युद्धोन्मुखत…

verses.sanskrit: दैत्येन्द्राणां विनाशाय दृश्यन्ते कालनिर्मिताः। ततो हिरण्यकशिपुर्गदामादाय सत्वरम्॥३४॥
verses.english: Air infused with fire and fire suffused with air, and undergoing an ictus of era-ending anger, as it were, that twosome airfire has incinerated the demonic army …

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यद्रवत वेगेन धरणीमनुकम्पयन्। हिरण्यकशिपुर्दैत्यो पदा संसृष्टवान्महीम्॥३५॥
verses.english: Swerving his broad bloodshot eyes all over, standing upright with upsurged fervour like lofty Mt. मन्दर, he readied himself in battlefield to put whichever host of gods that comes first in eyeshot distance to torch…

verses.sanskrit: सन्दष्टौष्ठपुटः क्रोधाद्वराह इव पूर्वजः। मेदिन्यां कम्प्यमानायां दैत्येन्द्रेण महात्मना॥३६॥
महीधरेभ्यो नागेन्द्रा निपेतुर्भयविक्तवाः। विषज्वालाकुलैर्वक्त्रैर्विमुञ्चन्तो हुताशनम्॥३७॥
verses.english: Firegod felt accomplished in his work when the limbs of some dAnavA-s are charmed, some fell down, some trying to rise but turning head over heels, while some completely ruined… when airgod shouldered every aircraft of demons down everybody felt that they are relived of the magical spell created by demons, and started eulogising shrIhari…

verses.sanskrit: चतुःशीर्षाः पञ्चशीर्षाः सप्तशीर्षाश्च पन्नगाः। वासुकिस्तक्षकश्चैव कर्कोटकधनञ्जयौ॥३८॥
verses.english: When the daityA-s remained unventuresome, hitherto laid harpy-deterrents in three worlds became null, and the gods everywhere delightedly said ‘excellent, superb, splendid…’

verses.sanskrit: एलापत्रश्च कालीयो महापद्मश्च वीर्यवान्। सहस्रशीर्षधृङ्नागो हेमतालध्वजः प्रभुः॥३९॥
verses.english: When इन्द्र achieved victory and demon मय met with discomfiture, all the quarters became clear and Vedic rituals recommenced…

verses.sanskrit: शेषोऽनन्तो महीपालो दुष्प्रकम्पः प्रकम्पितः। दीप्तान्यन्तर्जलस्थानि पृथिवीधरणानि च॥४०॥
verses.english: The path of the moon cleared up, the sun placed in his path, all the elements restored to their natural order and men, fond of good conduct, functioned at ease…

verses.sanskrit: तदा क्रुद्धेन दैत्येन कम्पितानि समन्ततः। पातालतलचारिण्यो नागतेजोधराः शिवाः॥४१॥
verses.english: Death so far constrained to cause timely deaths is now unconstrained and he is not causing untimely deaths – अ-काल मृत्यु-s, vedic-litany to firegod resumed, and the gods regularly receiving the shares of fire-oblations have reassumed a regular ushership to heaven for the oblators…

verses.sanskrit: आपश्च सहसा क्रुद्धा दुष्प्रकम्प्यरसाः शुभाः। नदी भागीरथी चैव सरयूः कौशिकी तथा॥४२॥
verses.english: The presiding deities of tend directions, दिक्-पालका-स्, are guarding them fairly unhindered to wend their way in their jurisdictions; saintly people have revived their ascesis unhampered by the transgressors…

verses.sanskrit: यमुना चैव कावेरी कृष्णा वेणा तथैव च। सुवेणा च महाभागा नदी गोदावरी तथा॥४३॥
verses.english: At that time gods bloc is jubilant while demons camp despaired; dharma is tripodal while a-dharma is a monopod…

verses.sanskrit: चर्मण्वती च सिन्धुश्च तथा नदनदीपतिः। मेकलप्रभवश्चैव शोणो मणिनिभोदकः॥४४॥
सुस्रोता नर्मदा चैव तथा वेत्रवती नदी। गोमती गोकुलाकीर्णा तथा पूर्णा सरस्वती॥४५॥
verses.english: The empyreal gates – मोक्श कवाटा-s, are wide open while people started to trek on the avenue of virtue; people in this world stood firm with their caste-bound duties, or hermitage bound missions… The ongoing trend of kings bracing the protection of people has picked up from where it has been left off… everywhere eulogies and legends in praise of gods became audible again…

verses.sanskrit: मही कालनदी चैव तमसा पुण्यवाहिनी। सिता चेक्षुमती चैव देविका च महानदी॥४६॥
verses.english: The empyreal gates – मोक्श कवाटा-s, are wide open while people started to trek on the avenue of virtue; people in this world stood firm with their caste-bound duties, or hermitage bound missions… The ongoing trend of kings bracing the protection of people has picked up from where it has been left off… everywhere eulogies and legends in praise of gods became audible again…

verses.sanskrit: जम्बूद्वीपं रत्नवन्तं सर्वरत्नोपशोभितम्। सुवर्णकूटकं चैव सुवर्णाकरमण्डितम्॥४७॥
verses.english: On hearing about the terror experienced by the opposers of gods - पूर्व-देवा-s - namely daityA-s, caused to the maximum by firegod and airgod, a demon renowned as काल-नेमि appeared on the battlefield…

verses.sanskrit: महानदश्च लोहित्यः शैलकाननशोभितः। पत्तनं कौशिकारण्यं द्रविडं रजताकरम्॥४८॥
verses.english: Seeing the world with silenced vice and nullified ultra-ascesis with parlous outcome, then firegod and airgod have beaten a retreat from further warring, for which the people at large, rather mother earth, smiled her gratitude at fire and air gods since some of her burden is doffed with war, and sung praise-songs for them…

verses.sanskrit: मागधांश्च महाग्रामानङ्गान्वङ्गांस्तथैव च। सुह्मान्मल्लान्विदेहांश्च मालवान्काशिकोसलान्॥४९॥
verses.english: Appearing mountainous like Mt. मन्दर, with an equally lofty crown in the shape of solar disc, adorned with jingling ornaments, mighty biceps bedecked with prestigious bicep-lets, whole body enswathed with high silver gear…

verses.sanskrit: भुवनं वैनतेयस्य सुवर्णस्य च कम्पितम्। कैलासशिखराकारं यत्कृतं विश्वकर्मणा॥५०॥
verses.english: Sporting a coppery hair akin to fire that burns summertime dry grass, and a greenish beard, faces with teeth jutting out of lips, his body seemed to be jutting into the interstices of all the three worlds… such is his lofty look…

verses.sanskrit: रक्ततोयो भीमवेगो लौहित्यो नाम सागरः। शुभः पाण्डरमेघाभः क्षीरोदश्चैव सागरः॥५१॥
verses.english: His arms appeared to be maintaining equiponderance of skies, his feet footballing mountains, and suspires shoving black-clouds to smithereens…

verses.sanskrit: उदयश्चैव राजेन्द्र उच्छ्रितः शतयोजनम्। सुपर्णवेदिकः श्रीमान्नागपक्षिनिषेवितः॥५२॥
verses.english: Swerving his broad bloodshot eyes all over, standing upright with upsurged fervour like lofty Mt. मन्दर, he readied himself in battlefield to put whichever host of gods that comes first in eyeshot distance to torch…

verses.sanskrit: भ्राजमानोऽर्कसदृशैर्जातरूपमयैर्द्रुमैः। शालैस्तालैस्तमालैश्च कर्णिकाभिश्च पुष्पितेः॥५३॥
verses.english: Terrorising hosts of gods, pervading all ten directions, he looked to have risen as an overbearing and overwrought Death appearing at era-endings…

verses.sanskrit: अयोमुखश्च विपुलः सर्वतो धातुमण्डितः। तमालवनगन्धश्च पर्वतो मलयः शुभः॥५४॥
verses.english: Raising his right hand showing his palm as a sign of assurance – अभय हस्तम् – stretching long fingers, full with garlands and ornaments on his body, with a little disordered armour, yet a wonder to have a look, addressed the demons routed by gods, “Get up, stand up, never give up the fight…”

verses.sanskrit: सुराष्ट्राञ्च सुबाह्लीकाः शूराभीरास्तथैव च। भोजाः पाण्डयाश्च वङ्गाश्च कलिङ्गास्तानलिप्तकाः॥५५॥
verses.english: Seeing such a demon काल-नेमि on the battlefield, one who is like Death himself unto his enemies, the hearts of celestials wobbled with fear…

verses.sanskrit: तथैवान्ध्राश्च पुण्ड्राश्च वामचूडाः सकेरलाः। क्षोभिस्तास्तेन दैत्येन सदेवाः साप्सरोगणाः॥५६॥
verses.english: On seeing his long strides other beings mistook demon काल-नेमि for the god नारायण dawned afresh as another त्रिविक्रम…

verses.sanskrit: अगस्तभुवनं चैव यदगम्यं पुरा कृतम्। सिद्धचारणसङ्घैश्च सेवितं सुमनोहरम्॥५७॥
verses.english: When that असुर काल-नेमि put his best foot forward on the battlefield as war-tramping, for which stamping the airgod could shove his loincloth a little aside, which terrorised all the gods since it indicated that he is primed up for a fresh war – युद्धोन्मुखत…

verses.sanskrit: विचित्रनागविहगं सुपुष्पितलताद्रुमम्। जातरूपमयैःशृङ्गेरप्सरोगणसेवितम्॥५८॥
verses.english: And when demon काल-नेमि strutted on battlefield clipping demon मय he shone forth like विष्णु walking with Mt. मन्दर…

verses.sanskrit: गिरिः पुष्पतकश्चैव लक्ष्मीवान्प्रियदर्शनः। उत्थितः सागरं भित्त्वा वयस्यश्चन्द्रसूर्ययोः॥५९॥
verses.english: Thereupon beholding the dreadful demon काल-नेमि approach like death himself all the gods headed by इन्द्र have undergone a macabre eeriness…

verses.sanskrit: रराज सुमहाशृङ्गैर्गगनं विलिखन्निव। सूर्यचन्द्रांशुसङ्काशैः सागराम्बुसमावृतः॥६०॥
विद्युद्वान्पर्वतः श्रीमानायातः शतयोजनम्। विद्युतां यत्र सम्पाता निपात्यन्ते नगोत्तमे॥६१॥
ऋषभः पर्वतश्चैव श्रीमानुषभसंस्थितः। कुञ्जरः पर्वतश्चैव यत्रागस्त्यगृहं महत्॥६२॥
विशाखरथ्या दुर्धर्षा सर्पाणामालया पुरी। तथा भोगवती चापि दैत्येन्द्रेणाभिकम्पिता॥६३॥
महामेघगिरिश्चैव पारियात्रश्च पर्वतः। चक्रवांस्तु गिरिः श्रेष्ठो वाराहश्चैव पर्वतः॥६४॥
प्राग्ज्योतिषपुरं चैव जातरूपमयं शुभम्। यस्मिन्वसति दुष्टात्मा नरको नाम दानवः॥६५॥
मेरुश्च पर्वतश्रेष्ठो मेघगम्भीरनिःस्वनः। षष्टिं तत्र सहस्राणि पर्वतानां विशाम्पते॥६६॥
तरुणादित्यसङ्काशो महेन्द्रश्च महागिरिः। देवावासः शुभः पुण्यो गिरिराजो दिवं गतः॥६७॥
हेमशृङ्गो महाशैलस्तथा मेघसखो गिरिः। कैलासश्चापि दुष्कम्पो दानवेन्द्रेण कम्पितः॥६८॥
यक्षराक्षसगन्धर्वैर्नित्यं सेवितकन्दरः। श्रीमान्मनोहरश्चैव नित्यं पुष्पितपादपः॥६९॥
हेमपुष्करसञ्छन्नं तेन वैखानसं सरः। कम्पितं मानसं चैव राजहंसैर्निषेवितम्॥७०॥
विशृङ्गः पर्वतश्चैव कुमारी च सरिद्वरा। तुषारचयसङ्काशो मन्दरश्चैव पर्वेतः॥७१॥
उशीरबीजश्च गिरी रुद्रोपस्थस्तथाद्विराट्। प्रजापतेश्च निलयस्तथा पुष्करपर्वतः॥७२॥
देवावृत्पर्वतश्चैव तथा वै वालुको गिरिः। क्रौञ्चः सप्तर्षिशैलश्च धूमवर्णश्च पर्वतः॥७३॥
एते चान्ये च गिरयो देशा जनपदास्तथा। नद्यश्च सागराश्चैव दानवेन्द्रेण कम्पिताः॥७४॥
कपिलश्च महीपुत्रो व्याघ्राक्षश्चैव कम्पितः। खेचराश्च निशापुत्राः पातालतलवासिनः॥७५॥
गणास्तथा परे रौद्रा मेघनादाङ्‌कुशायुधाः। ऊर्ध्वगो भीमवेगश्च सर्व एवाभिकम्पिताः॥७६॥
